corrections.title: Standalone EffectIntent closure: each standalone effect gets its own Sequencer initiation rule with effect-specific checks, never the attempt-scoped permit, reservation or fence checks. Staging delete: an eligible staging ref, an ACCEPTED sequence or expired retention, the expected ref value known, cleanup authority from an immutable, previously established source, a bounded intent (t-g01); under remote_delete an absent ref is HAPPENED (t-g02), a ref at another value is ABSENT and returns to RETAINED (t-g03), and UNKNOWN_OUTCOME holds in DELETING. Workspace sync: an established canonical source, an eligible target, the INV-46 safety predicate, a bounded intent (t-w01); when the predicate fails there is no intent and no ref mutation, and it ends SKIPPED with the WorkspaceSyncReceipt recording SKIPPED (t-w03)
